translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Lamo mar ngʼat mawinjo marach kendo machiwo ywakne e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.

content.text: Winj lamona, yaye Jehova Nyasaye;
yie irwak lamona ma akwayigo kony.
Kik ipandna wangʼi sa ma chunya lit.
Chikna iti; ka aluongi to dwoka mapiyo.
Nimar ndalona rumo piyo ka iro;
chokena rewni ka kit kendo maliet.
Chunya orewore kendo oner ka lum;
wiya wil kata mana gi chamo chiemba.
Chur ma achurgo matek
omiyo adhero alokora choke lilo.
Achalo gi tula mar bungu,
achalo gi tula modak e gunda.
Asiko aneno anena,
achalo gi winyo man kende ewi osuri.
Odiechiengʼ duto wasika kinya ka gijara;
joma dhawona konyore gi nyinga kaka gir kwongʼruok.
Nimar achamo buch kendo kaka chiemba
kendo ariwo mathna gi pi wangʼa,
nikech mirimbi maduongʼ,
nimar isekawa mi iwita gichien.
Ndalona chalo gi tipo modhiambo;
aner adwaro two ka lum.
In to ibet e kom lochni nyaka chiengʼ, yaye Jehova Nyasaye;
humbi osiko e tienge duto.
Ibiro aa malo mi ikech Sayun,
nimar sa osechopo monego ongʼwonee;
sa mochanne osechopo.
Nimar kitene beyo gi lala ne jotichni,
kata mana buru madum kuome miyo ji keche.
Ogendini biro luoro nying Jehova Nyasaye,
ruodhi duto mag piny biro luoro duongʼni.
Nimar Jehova Nyasaye biro gero Sayun
kendo obiro thinyore e lela e duongʼne.
Obiro dwoko lamo mar ngʼama ok nyal
kendo ok obi chayo lamogi.
Wachni mondo ondik piny ne tiengʼ mabiro,
mondo joma pok onywol opak Jehova Nyasaye:
“Jehova Nyasaye nongʼiyo piny gie kare maler man malo,
nongʼiyo piny gie polo,
mondo owinj ywak joma otwe
kendo ogony joma ongʼadnegi buch tho.”
Kuom mano nying Jehova Nyasaye ibiro hul e Sayun,
ibiro pake e Jerusalem,
ka joma odak e pinjeruodhi ochokore
mondo olam Jehova Nyasaye.
Ka noyudo ngimana dhi maber to nomiyo tekona odok chien
kendo nongʼado ngimana odoko machiek.
Omiyo ne awacho niya,
“Kik ikaw ngimana, yaye Nyasacha, kapod an e chuny ngima;
in to isiko ingima nyaka tienge duto.
Kar chakruok ne iketo mise mag piny,
kendo polo bende gin tij lweti.
Gin to ginilal nono in to isiko manyaka chiengʼ;
giduto giniti mana kaka law ti.
Ibiro lokogi kaka iloko law
kendo ibiro witgi.
In to isiko ichalri mana kaka in,
kendo hiki ok norum.
Nyithind jotichni biro dak buti machiegni;
nyikwagi nodhi maber e nyimi.”
